silhouette.reason: Bigger octagonal turret with team roof, shorter gun with brake, chevron prow, side stowage boxes breaking the hull line: reads as a light tank from every view.
fixes: a stowage basket on the turret rear so the turret outline is not one block

proportions.reason: 6.1 x 3.1 x 3.2 m, gun now ~0.6 of hull length, turret scaled up for the RTS read.
fixes: road wheels ~5% bigger so they fill the track run

materials.reason: Chips are smaller and fewer, but on the large bone plates they still read as wood-grain dashes; the glowing headlamps are flat yellow octagons that read as stickers, and the rubber tyres look like wood.
fixes: round, edge-biased chips on a steel_painted variant
lamp lenses with a rim and a lower glow strength
dark rubber on the road-wheel tyres

detail.reason: Bolt rows on glacis and turret edges, weld seams, side stowage, spare links, hatch, periscope, antenna, grille, tool rack.
fixes: a tow cable on the rear plate
track guide horns and sprocket teeth

wear.reason: Rusty mud on the tracks and a dusty lower hull; the uniform dash chips still read as a texture rather than history, and there is no exhaust soot.
fixes: soot streaks on the rear plate
heavier mud on the lower hull sides

lod.reason: lods.png: LOD2 (598 tris) replaces the running gear with a solid belt slab, the road wheels vanish and the lamps go, so the side outline changes at RTS zoom. This was asked last round and not done.
fixes: keep 6 road-wheel discs per side inside an open belt at LOD2 (running.ts)

technical.reason: QA PASS: 32.1k / 8.3k / 598 tris; 23 / 23 / 7 draws at LOD0/1 is heavy for an RTS unit.
fixes: merge the static road-wheel pivots into one draw per side
